A method in accordance with claim 17, wherein each of said consistency rules is associated with a natural language description of the relationship which should be fulfilled by data in accordance with the consistency relationship defined by said consistency rule, wherein said labels in said output presentation comprise said natural language description.

19. A computer apparatus for generating consistency link data, said consistency link data, identifying data within structured documents which does or does not fulfil the requirements of a formal set of consistency relationships, comprising: means for inputting a set of one or more structured documents containing data; means for storing a set of one or more consistency rules, each of said consistency rules defining a relationship which may be fulfilled by data within structured documents having pre-defined structures; and means for processing said structured documents and said consistency rules to generate said consistency link data, identifying within said set of structured documents, data which does or does not fulfil said relationships defined by said set of consistency rules.

20. An apparatus in accordance with claim 19, wherein
said means for processing said structured documents and said consistency rules is arranged to generate consistency link data identifying data with in a set of structured documents, data which does fulfil said relationships defined by a said set of consistency rules.

21. An apparatus in accordance with claim 19 or 20, wherein said means for processing said structured documents and said consistency rules is arranged to generate consistency link data identifying data with in a set of structured documents, data which does not fulfil said relationships defined by a said set of consistency rules .

22. An apparatus in accordance with any of claims 19 to 21, further comprising selection means for selecting one or more documents from an input set of structured documents containing data, wherein said means for processing said structured documents and said consistency rules is arranged to generate consistency link data identifying data within said documents selected by said selection means which does or does not fulfil said relationships defined by said set of consistency rules.

23. An apparatus according to any of claims 19 to 22, wherein said means for processing said structured documents and said consistency rules to generate consistency link data comprises: means for identifying within said structured documents data which may fulfil the relationship defined
by a said consistency rule; means for testing said identified data to determine which of said data fulfils or does not fulfil the relationship defined by a said consistency rule; and means for generating consistency link data, identifying data which does or does not fulfil a required consistency relationship on the basis of said determination .

24. An apparatus according to claim 23, wherein said means for storing a set of one or more consistency rules is arranged for storing a set of consistency rules, wherein each of said consistency rules in said set of consistency rules is associated with one or more pointers, said pointers being pointers to parts of a predefined structure for structured documents containing data, and wherein said means for identifying is arranged to identify data utilising a set of pointers associated with a said consistency rule.

25. Apparatus according to claim 23 or claim 24, wherein said means for storing said one or more consistency rules is arranged to store consistency rules when each of said consistency rules is associated with a condition, wherein said means for testing said identified data is arranged to test data by determining whether identified data does or does not fulfil a condition associated with a said consistency rule.

26. An apparatus according to claim 25, wherein said
means for testing is arranged to test identified data on the basis of a comparison operation associated with each of said consistency rules.

27. An apparatus according to claim 25 or claim 26, wherein said means for storing a set of one or more consistency rules is arranged to store a set of consistency rules, each of said consistency rules having associated therewith a first or second data generation category, wherein said means for generating consistency link data is arranged to generate consistency link data where said consistency rule is associated with a first data generation category and it is determined that for data identified which may fulfil a relationship defined by said consistency rule no other data exists which fulfils with said data said condition associated with said consistency rule and wherein said means for generating consistency link data is arranged not to generate consistency link data where a said consistency rule is associated with said second data generation category and it is determined that the data identified which may fulfil that relationship defined by said consistency rule no other data exists which fulfils with said data said condition associated with said consistency rule.

28. An apparatus according to any of claims 25 to 27, wherein said means for storing a set of one or more consistency rules, is arranged to store a set of consistency rules, each of said consistency rules having
an associated link status category, wherein said means for generating consistency link data is arranged to generate data identifying the consistency rule which causes the generation of said consistency link data and status data indicative of whether said identified data does or does not fulfil the relationship defined by said consistency rule, wherein the value of said status data is determined by whether identified data does or does not fulfil the condition associated with said consistency rule and the link status category associated with said consistency rule.
29. An apparatus in accordance with any of claims 19 to 28 further comprising, means for inputting a set of one or more consistency rules for storage in said means for storing.

30. An apparatus in accordance with any of claims 19 to 29, further comprising: monitoring means for monitoring a set of one or more structured documents containing data to determine whether any of said documents have been amended; and initiation means for initiating the generation of further consistency link data on the basis of said determination.

31. An apparatus in accordance with claim 30, wherein said monitoring means is arranged to determine whether the time stamp of a document in said set of one or more structured documents has been amended and if the time
stamp of a document has been amended, to determine which if any portions of data within said document have been updated.

32. An apparatus in accordance with claim 31, further comprising determination means for determining which consistency link data of previously generated consistency link data may be affected by change made to identified portions of a said structured document; and deletion means for deleting any of said previously generated consistency link data which may have been affected by said amendment of said identified portions, wherein said means for processing said structured documents and said consistency rules to generate said consistency link data is arranged to generate further consistency link data comprising consistency link data identifying data within said identifying portions of said documents following said deletion by said deletion means. 33. A computer apparatus for generating an output presentation identifying data within structured documents which does or does not fulfil the requirements of a set of consistency relationships defined by a set of consistency rules comprising: computer apparatus for generating consistency link data in accordance with any of claims 19 to 32, processing means for processing said consistency link data to generate an output presentation; and output means for outputting said output presentation.

34. An apparatus in accordance with claim 33, wherein said processing means is arranged to process said consistency link data and said set of one or more structured documents to generate an output presentation comprising a set of link documents, said set of linked documents comprising a set of one or more documents containing data being representations of said structured documents, wherein the data of said linked set of documents is linked on the basis of said consistency link data thereby identifying data which does or does not fulfil a set of formal consistency relationships defined by said set of consistency rules.

35. An apparatus in accordance with claim 33 or 34, wherein said processing means is arranged to process said set of one or more consistency rules defining said formal set of consistency requirements wherein said means for storing a set of one or more consistency rules is arranged to store a set of consistency rules, each of said consistency rules having associated therewith label data, said processing means being arranged to generate an output presentation further comprising labels labelling data identified by said consistency link data as fulfilling or not fulfilling the requirements of a consistency relationship defined by a set of consistency rules .

36. An apparatus in accordance with claim 35, wherein said means for storing a set of one or more consistency rules is arranged to store a set of one or more
consistency rules each having associated therewith a natural language description of the relationship which should be fulfilled by data in accordance with the consistency relationship defined by said consistency rule, wherein said processing means is arranged to generate an output presentation wherein said natural language descriptions are used to label data which does or does not fulfil a requirement of a set of consistency rules .

37. A computer apparatus for generating a set of consistency rules for use in any of the computer apparatus of claims 19 to 32, said rules defining relationships which may be fulfilled by data with in structured documents having a predefined structure, said apparatus comprising: selection means for selecting one or more portions of a data structure defining the structure of a document which is to be filled by data; and input means for inputting a condition against which data from within documents in accordance with said predefined structure found at said portions is to be tested to determine whether date does or does not fulfil a required relationship.

38. An apparatus in accordance with claim 37, wherein said input means is further arranged for inputting a data generation category to be associated with said consistency rule, wherein said data generation categories determine whether or not consistency link data is
generated for said rule when no data exists which fulfils the condition of said consistency rule.

39. An apparatus in accordance with claim 37 or claim 38, wherein said input means is further arranged for inputting a links data category, wherein said category such as to determine the value of status data associated with consistency link data generated in accordance with said consistency rule in dependence upon whether date identified does or does not form the condition the associated with said consistency rule.

40. An apparatus in accordance with any of claims 37 to 39, wherein said input means is further arranged for inputting a natural language description of a consistency relationship defined by a said consistency rule, wherein said natural language description is arranged to be used for the generation of labels in an output presentation.
41. A data carrier having recorded thereon a computer program for generating within a computer an apparatus in accordance with any of claims 19 to 40.
42. A data carrier in accordance with claim 41 comprising a computer disc.
43. A computer disc in accordance with claim 42, wherein said computer disc comprises an optical magneto-optical or magnetic disc .
44. A data carrier in accordance with claim 41, comprising an electrical signal transferred via the Internet .

45. A method for generating consistency link data within a computer apparatus, said consistency link data, identifying data within structured documents which does or does not fulfil the requirements of a formal set of consistency relationships, substantially as herein described with reference to any of the accompanying drawings .

46. An apparatus for generating consistency link data, said consistency link data, identifying data within structured documents which does or does not fulfil the requirements of a formal set of consistency relationships, substantially as herein described with reference to any of the accompanying drawings .
